title: Initialize fumadocs documentation site at /apps/site
body:
Migrates the official documentation site from VitePress to Fumadocs, establishing the new site at `/apps/site` using a multi-package architecture.

## Changes

- **Site Structure** 
  - Next.js 15 app at `/apps/site` with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Fumadocs UI
  - MDX-based documentation in `content/docs/` (Introduction, Quick Start, Installation)
  - Homepage with navigation, docs layout with sidebar

- **Configuration**
  - Added fumadocs-core, fumadocs-mdx, fumadocs-ui dependencies
  - Configured Next.js with MDX support via `next.config.mjs`
  - Tailwind preset for Fumadocs UI components
  - Source config in `source.config.ts` for MDX compilation

- **Monorepo Integration**
  - Added `/apps/*` to pnpm-workspace.yaml
  - Root scripts: `site:dev`, `site:build`, `site:start`
  - Updated `.gitignore` for Next.js and Fumadocs artifacts

## Known Issue

Route generation requires API compatibility fix between fumadocs-mdx `.source` exports (wrapped by `_runtime.doc()`) and the loader. Build succeeds but pages return 404. Requires investigation of fumadocs 15.x integration pattern.

```typescript
// Current workaround - manual mapping from .source
const mappedDocs = docs
  .filter((doc: any) => doc && doc.info && doc.info.path)
  .map((doc: any) => ({
    type: 'page' as const,
    path: doc.info.path.replace(/\.mdx?$/, ''),
    data: { ...doc.data, body: doc.data.default },
  }));
```
